landing.title: Welcome to KaushalPath
landing.subtitle: Discover the right vocational career for you and your family.

how.title: How It Works
how.subtitle: Three steps from an empty form to a career decision the whole family agrees on.

steps.title: Take the assessment
steps.desc: Answer a short set of questions about your studies, budget, district and the things that matter to you.

steps.title: Get ranked matches
steps.desc: KaushalPath ranks NSQF vocational options for your profile and shows the factors behind every position.

steps.title: Decide together
steps.desc: Open a Family Decision Room, let everyone weigh the factors, vote, and reach a consensus with a counsellor.

features.title: What's Inside
features.subtitle: Every screen is built around one question: why this career, for this family?

items.title: Explainable ranking
items.desc: Each recommendation shows the reasons behind it — cost, duration, salary, local jobs and distance.

items.title: Family Decision Room
items.desc: Student, parents and a counsellor compare up to three options in the same room.

items.title: What matters, weighted
items.desc: Each person slides their own weights and the family score updates live.

items.title: Vote to consensus
items.desc: Ratings turn into an agreement score and a suggested next step on the roadmap.

items.title: Ask-box for doubts
items.desc: Tap a concern — cost, distance, job safety — and get an answer in your language.

items.title: Counsellor cockpit
items.desc: Cohort filters, analytics, resistance flags and an audit trail for every recorded override.

who.title: Who It's For
who.subtitle: One flow, three points of view.

items.title: Students
items.desc: Find a vocational path that fits your marks, your budget and your district.

items.title: Parents
items.desc: See why an option ranks first, and settle on it together in your own language.

items.title: Counsellors and admins
items.desc: Track a whole cohort, spot resistance, and record corrections with a reason.

cta.title: Start with one assessment.
cta.subtitle: Create a profile, answer the questions, and see which vocational careers rank highest for your family.

footer.blurb: Vocational career counselling for students, parents and counsellors — ranked matches with the reasons attached.
footer.copyright: © 2026 KaushalPath. Vocational career guidance, ranked with the reasons attached.

consent.title: Data Consent
consent.description: We need your consent to store your profile and assessment data for recommendations.

settings.title: Settings
settings.delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete all your data? This cannot be undone.

ask.title: Have a concern? Tap a question
ask.a_cost: For {{career}}, the fee depends on the exact course. We only rank options that fit the budget you set — you can change that in your profile.
ask.a_far: We rank {{career}} higher when a centre is close to your district. Allowing relocation in your profile widens the options.
ask.a_jobs: {{career}} is shown partly on local demand and placement signals from market data. These figures are demo data until real sources are loaded.
ask.a_stable: Stability for {{career}} is judged on demand index and NSQF alignment. You can ask a counsellor to review it for a human opinion.
ask.recorded: Thanks — we've noted this concern so a counsellor can follow up.
